full_judgment:
6. The learned Single Judge of the High Court Division set aside the judgment of the lower appellate Court and restored the judgment of the trial Court as the same was not a proper judgment of reversal on consideration of material evidence in the case. 

 10. Thus on the material point as to the reversal of the judgment of the trial Court, the lower appellate Court being the last Court of fact did not reverse the judgment after setting aside all the material evidence and misconception of law and fact and the learned Single Judge was within his competence to set aside the judgment of the lower appellate Court and restore that of the trial Court, thereby dismissing the suit.
